runner: ParseSection(input), then section.leg.Ref() when the parse succeeded; expect is ok (and headerBytes = the length of the header the reference holds) or the canonical state

vectors.name: leg_header_valid
vectors.note: the real Base Sepolia header of the leg block: bound to blockHash and blockNumber

vectors.name: leg_header_absent
vectors.note: no headerRlp: the member predating this field, read as before

vectors.name: leg_header_of_another_block
vectors.note: a real header of another block (Adiri 498759): keccak256(header) is not the carried blockHash

vectors.name: leg_header_wrong_block_number
vectors.note: the header hashes to blockHash but its positional number is not the carried blockNumber

vectors.name: leg_header_odd_length
vectors.note: an odd number of hex digits

vectors.name: leg_header_empty
vectors.note: an empty header is not a header: omit the member instead

vectors.name: leg_header_not_a_block_header
vectors.note: valid hex of an RLP list with no items: ReadHeader names it (the part of a block header that is missing)
